pack.title: ResPlan residential floor plans
pack.attribution: Floor plans: ResPlan (Agour et al. 2025), CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/m-agour/ResPlan
pack.notes: TEST FIXTURE — 6 plans copied from the resplan pack. geometry recovered from real-estate listing renderings; provenance withheld by the authors; takedown policy applies — treat as lower-trust than Swiss Dwellings. Metres come from each plan's own area field (scale = sqrt(area_m2 / sum(room polygon areas))); wall thickness from wall_depth x that scale. The 683 augmented plans (area_change_sqft set) are excluded. The pickle does not document its y axis, so the schema flip z = -y is applied as written and plans may be mirrored north/south; mirror_ok is true.
